page_title: Remote oil and electricity control configuration and use
page_content:
[TOC]

### Installation list
| Name | Quantity | Name | Quantity |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ | ------------ |
| MDVR device | 1 | MDVR sensor out IO harness | 1 |
| Remote controller | 1 | Display | 1 |
| Relay | 1 | Common wiring tools | n |

### Necessary instructions
- The platform remotely sends commands to control the device sensor out output or shut down the 12V voltage to control the vehicle circuit or oil circuit
- Usage conditions: **IO output function must be equipped with oil/electricity control, the device must be positioned, and ACC must be closed**

![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5dacd17c0b198ff4fa9d80a74d184b7f)
**Actual picture**:

### Operation steps
#### 1. Wiring
The following figure does not include the schematic diagram of MDVR power connection. Please connect the positive and negative poles of the device's power supply and the yellow ACC line
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e7dcd45c3ab83c68a7dafea5ea5003b7)

#### 2. Device or platform menu configuration
**Device**
Remote control to enter Settings>>Alarm Settings>>Output, Output 1 Select Oil Control, confirm to save and restart to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5b89203858c5815d5438bdbc6e223938)
ps: Function output 1 corresponds to sensor out1 IO line, output 2 corresponds to sensor out2. Some devices have two sensor out lines, such as M51HV. Which one is used according to the actual wiring configuration.
**Platform**
2.1 Log in to the platform client, select the vehicle to be controlled online, right-click and select Parameter Configuration Plug-in
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=630ffe6a3a518d646b4b20b48074f939)
2.2 Click Alarm Settings>>Output>>Output 1>>Oil Control or Electric Control>>Set Parameters. After the configuration is completed, remotely restart the device to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=1dc8302b1516bc9eb5000527a3d0bf79)

#### 3. Test
3.1 Click Information Management>>Vehicle Information in the platform menu. Select the vehicle just configured. Click the Edit icon. In the Device Information column, check Oil Controller or Circuit Controller and confirm to save.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=04d07ea55bd13100e0fc79578494342d)

3.2 Click the real-time preview menu to return to the monitoring vehicle interface, click online control vehicle>>control module menu>>disconnect oil circuit or turn off the power, and a login password input window pops up. Enter the correct password, confirm, and the pop-up "disconnect oil circuit, success" indicates that the control command is successfully issued and the device disconnects the oil circuit.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=48f2332800ceff5cc9092655e030c8ed)![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=3fa75b80ff6b8ea2ac0f6e141ba100de)![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=339dd9fedfad940e3ae8442edf1b6000)

### Frequently Asked Questions
Oil or electricity control failed?
1. Check the wiring between the device, relay and controlled device, and the relay is normal and available
2. This function requires the device to be positioned normally. Check whether the device has been positioned. The ACC status of the device must be closed. Please disconnect the ACC line
3. The output function of sensor out must be consistent with the function of the operation. For example, if the wiring uses sensor out1, the output function of sensor out1 is set to oil control on the device side
